# Italian voice commands. Most lines are from the vendor's published Italian command list (used as a coverage checklist);
# lines the list lacks, or leaves in English, were translated for this project and have NOT been reviewed by a native speaker.
# Format: English => Italian. {braces} mark the variable part; tests remove the braces.
